login.title: Sign in
login.failed: The login identifier or the password is wrong, or the account is not active.

invitation.title: Set your password
invitation.intro: You were invited to {{hostname}}. Choose a password to activate your account.
invitation.done: Your account is active. Sign in with your login identifier and the password you chose.
invitation.invalid: This invitation is not valid any more. Ask your administrator for a new one.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.forbidden: Your account does not have permission to see this page.
errors.notFound: There is no page at this address.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone who can sign in to this tenant: people and service accounts.

record.notFoundText: There is no user at this address that you may see. Check the link, or go back to the list.
record.failed: The user could not be loaded.

grid.capped: The page size was limited to {{max}} rows (asked for more than the API allows); showing {{size}} per page.

accents.primary: The platform accent: the main action on a page, links and the focus ring.
accents.identity: The Identity module: its opener, its navigation mark and its pattern.
accents.console: The tenant console: organisation units, roles, entitlements, flags and settings.
accents.success: Something worked: a saved record, an activated account. Always with a word or an icon.
accents.warning: Something needs attention before it goes wrong. Always with a word or an icon.
accents.danger: Something failed, or will destroy data if confirmed. Always with a word or an icon.
accents.info: Something worth knowing that needs no action. Always with a word or an icon.

neutral.ink: Text and strokes: a near-black with a hint of blue, and its light counterpart on dark paper.
neutral.paper: Surfaces: a warm off-white, and a cool near-black. Pure black and pure white are not used.
neutral.gray: The light scheme greys: hovers at 0, borders at 4, dimmed text at 6.
neutral.dark: The dark scheme greys: the ink at 0, dimmed text at 2, borders at 4, the paper at 7.

gallery.title: Design gallery
gallery.intro: Every token and every themed component, in both schemes and both densities. Development builds only; the accessibility scan reads this page.

colour.scalesIntro: Ten shades per colour, lightest first, generated from one hue and one chroma on one lightness table.
colour.pairsIntro: The pairs Mantine renders from the tokens, measured as the browser paints them. Text needs 4.5:1; a border or a focus ring needs 3:1 and is shown as a box.
colour.swatch: A box drawn in the foreground colour on the background colour

type.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
type.heading: Heading level {{order}}
type.display: Display titles, for the moments only

space.durations: Quick, {{quick}} ms, for a change under the pointer; calm, {{calm}} ms, for something that arrives or leaves.

components.textDescription: Shown to other people in your tenant.
components.alertText: Status is never colour alone: a title and an icon say what it is.
components.paperText: A bordered surface for a record or a form.
components.textBody: Body text in the reading family, at the size of the work.
components.textDimmed: Dimmed text for hints and secondary lines, still at 4.5:1.
components.anchorLead: A link is underlined, not only coloured:

grid.label: Sample records
grid.intro: Twenty rows from memory, paged by the grid as the API would; the density switch changes the row height.
grid.name: Name

views.brokenMessage: The gallery asked for an error on purpose.

drawings.marksIntro: Seeded from the hostname, so every tenant has something of its own with no configuration: acme and bravo, side by side.
drawings.patternsIntro: Symmetry 6, 8 and 12 at four rings, and the hatch that shades a drawing.
drawings.illustrationsIntro: Eleven drawings in one hand (brief section 3), each with its accessible name; the loader draws itself in unless motion is reduced.

templates.listDescription: A list: the opener, the filters, the density switch, the grid.
templates.listGrid: Sample records on the list template

record.title: Order 1042

events.changedSummary: The due date moved by a week.

record.comment: The customer asked for delivery before the end of the month.

wizard.title: New organisation unit
wizard.description: Three steps, with what you have entered beside them.

console.title: Tenant settings
console.description: Each section explains what it governs.
console.generalDescription: The name people see in the shell and in emails.

dashboard.title: Today
dashboard.description: Big numbers in the display family; the cards are the moment.

form.intro: Labels above, one column, validation after the first blur, one primary action at the end. Tick the box to get the answer the server would give: the email error lands on its field, the unknown one at the top with the correlation id.
form.displayNameHint: Shown to other people in your tenant.
form.likeTheServer: Answer like the server would for a taken email

dialogs.intro: A question with one primary answer and a way out; a form in a frame that keeps its one primary action.
dialogs.confirmMessage: Its records move to the parent unit. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.name: Name

illustrations.nothingYet: An open, empty box: nothing here yet.
illustrations.nothingFound: A magnifier over a blank page: nothing matches.
illustrations.noAccess: A closed door and a key: no access.
illustrations.allDone: A tray of finished documents with a tick: all done.
illustrations.lost: Someone with a map at a signpost: this page does not exist.
illustrations.broken: A clock on its side with its spring out: something broke.
illustrations.forbidden: A closed gate with a padlock: access refused.
illustrations.welcome: An open door with someone waving: welcome.
illustrations.home: A small building with its flag up: home.
illustrations.success: Someone holding up a stamped document: success.

approval.title: Approval
approval.placeholder: Approving and rejecting arrive with the workflow slice; the shape is here so pages can plan for it.

comments.title: Comments
comments.label: Your comment
comments.later: Comments arrive with a later slice; the shape is here so pages can plan for it.

units.title: Organisation units
units.description: The tree that roles, settings and records are scoped to.
units.name: Name
units.rootNote: The root stands for the whole tenant. It cannot move or be deactivated.
units.select: Choose a unit in the tree to see it here.
units.failed: The organisation units could not be loaded.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.hint: The unit moves with everything below it.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.message: {{name}} stays in the tree as inactive. No new units, records or role assignments can be placed in it.

form.codeShape: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit.
form.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; unique in this tenant.

empty.title: No organisation units yet
empty.text: The root unit appears when the tenant is provisioned.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: What people and service accounts may do. A role is a set of permissions; an assignment gives it at a scope.
roles.name: Name

import.title: Import roles
import.intro: Choose a role export from another tenant, or paste it. You see what would change before anything does.
import.notJson: This is not a role export. Choose the file, or paste it as the export wrote it.
import.dryRun: This is what the import would do. Nothing has changed yet.
import.unknownTitle: Permissions this tenant does not know
import.unknownText: The import cannot be applied while the document holds them. Remove them from the file, or import into a tenant that has those modules.
import.skippedNote: Every tenant has the system roles already; an import never changes them.

editor.notFoundText: There is no role at this address. It may have been deleted.
editor.failed: The role could not be loaded.
editor.systemNote: System roles come with Foundation and follow its permission catalogue, so nobody can change or delete them. To choose permissions yourself, create a tenant role.
editor.readOnlyNote: You can read this role. Changing roles needs the permission to manage roles for the whole tenant.

form.codeRequired: Enter a code of at least two characters.
form.codeShape: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
form.codeHint: It identifies the role in exports and cannot change later.
form.principalTypeHint: A role is for people or for service accounts, not both.
form.permissionsHint: Choose what the role allows. A role can hold only permissions you hold for the whole tenant.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.message: {{name}} will be gone for good. A role that is still assigned cannot be deleted: remove its assignments first.

holders.none: Nobody holds this role where you can see.

scopes.unit_with_children: This unit and the units below it

access.noRead: You cannot see who holds which role here. That needs the permission to read role assignments.
access.intro: The roles {{name}} holds and where each applies. You see the ones at units you may read.
access.noneText: This account holds no role you can see. Without one, it can sign in but do nothing.

grant.title: Grant a role to {{name}}
grant.unitRequired: Choose a unit on the tree.
grant.roleHint: Only roles for this kind of account are listed.
grant.includeChildrenHint: Without it, the role applies to this unit only.
grant.noUnits: You cannot see the organisation units, so you cannot grant a role at a unit here.
